posts.coverText: 6 questions to ask your boyfriend

slideText.text: Can you remember what I was wearing when we met?
What was your favorite date we've ever had? Why?
When did you first notice that I was falling for you?
What's your biggest fear for this relationship?
What's something I do all the time that drives you nuts?

posts.coverText: 5 funny questions you've never asked your girlfriend

slideText.text: If you had to kidnap me, how would you pull it off?
What's a habit of mine that's adorable but should annoy you?
If I was a burglar, what's the dumbest thing I'd steal?
What's something I do that makes you think, "That's my little weirdo"?
If you had to explain why we're together in 3 emojis, what would they be?

posts.coverText: Insanely cute questions to ask your boyfriend

slideText.text: What would your 10-year-old self love about me?
What one thing I do would you miss instantly if I stopped?
What part of me feels the most "yours"?
When did you first feel protective over me?
What do I look like when I'm trying not to smile at you?

posts.coverText: Let your girlfriend rate you out of 10

slideText.text: Rate my jealousy out of 10.
Rate how annoying I am out of 10.
Rate my flirting skills out of 10.
Rate my rizz out of 10.
Rate how dramatic I am out of 10.
Rate my texting speed out of 10.
Rate how childish I act around you out of 10.
Rate my chances of surviving without you out of 10.
Rate how good I am at making you laugh out of 10.
Rate my chances of being your husband out of 10.

posts.coverText: 5 ridiculously funny questions to ask your boyfriend

slideText.text: If you had to give me a completely new name, what would you pick?
If you could ban me from doing one thing forever, what would it be?
What's something I'm better at than anyone else you know?
If I came with a warning label, what would it say?
What's something you swear I'm good at but I'm actually terrible at?

posts.coverText: Ask him this... no sugarcoating

slideText.text: What's the hardest part about loving me?
What do you think I struggle with most in love?
What makes loving me worth it?
What do you think hurts me the fastest?

posts.coverText: 10 really uncomfortable but healthy questions for couples

slideText.text: What's something you've been keeping to yourself because you think I won't understand?
What's the hardest part about being with me?
What's the one thing about our relationship that scares you the most?
What's something you desperately want from this relationship that you're not getting?
What's a recent change you've noticed in me that you're afraid to bring up?
What's something about our relationship that's been bothering you?
What's a part of your life you wish I was more involved in?
What's a memory you have of me that hurts a little?
What's something you do for me that I never seem to notice?
What's something you can't talk to me about?

posts.coverText: deep questions for her

slideText.text: If someone else made you happier than I do, would you leave me?
Do you ever feel like you're holding back with me?
What's one thing you wish I understood about you?
What's something you wish I'd notice more about you?
Have you ever doubted my love for you?

posts.coverText: 5 funny yes or no questions

slideText.text: Do you have a specific photo you look at when you miss me?
Have you ever pretended to like something just to keep the peace?
Do you hide any part of your past from me?
Have you noticed anything new about me lately?
Would you still pick me if we met today?

posts.coverText: Things I wanna know but am afraid to ask

slideText.text: Is your life actually better with me in it?
Do you ever compare me to your past partners?
Are there things about me you wish I would change?
Have I ever disappointed you in a way you haven't told me?
Do you feel like you give more than you receive in our relationship?

posts.coverText: 7 questions for the perfect pillow talk

slideText.text: Before we met, did you think I'd be your type of person?
What's something you've never asked me for but always wanted from me?
If we were alone right now with no limits, what's the first thing you'd say to me?
What's one moment with me you still think about when you're alone?
If I blindfolded you for a surprise, what would you hope it is?
What's the most attractive thing about my energy to you?
What's a "wild" truth you've thought about me but never told me?

posts.coverText: 3 fun questions to ask your man

slideText.text: What's the first time you felt protective of me?
What's my most lovable flaw?
What's a little habit of mine you secretly love?

posts.coverText: 5 questions that feel like cuddling

slideText.text: What exactly made you want to see me a second time?
What did you expect me to judge you for, but I didn't?
What's the nicest thing you've said about me to someone else?
What's the first thing I did that actually scared you a little?
What's the weirdest thing you like about me?

posts.coverText: 5 questions that strengthen your forever

slideText.text: What's a tradition you want us to start?
What do you think makes our love last?
What kind of future are you dreaming of for us?
How do you imagine our mornings together 5 years from now?
What promise do you want us to keep, no matter what?

posts.coverText: 5 questions every boyfriend should be able to answer

slideText.text: What photo of me do you look at when you miss me?
What word always makes you think of me?
When you've had a bad day, what do you look forward to most about seeing me?
What's something I say or do that instantly makes everything feel a bit better?
What's one way my love has quietly made your life softer?

posts.coverText: Her 9 answers to these questions will make you cry

slideText.text: Out of all the people in the world, why do you choose me?
What's the most nervous you've ever been around me?
What's something I do that makes you think, "Yep, that's my person"?
Can you tell me one thing you've never told me before?
What's the one thing you wish I understood about you?
If you had to relive one moment with me, what would it be?
Is there anything I do for you that makes you happy every time I do it?
What's the first thing you told your friends about me?
How have I really impacted your life?

posts.coverText: 9 ridiculously fun questions for couples

slideText.text: How would you describe my face to someone who's never met me?
If I texted "don't be mad," what would you guess I did?
If our love story were a Netflix series, what would you call it?
What was the first thing you told your best friend about me?
If you had to change my legal name, what would you call me?
If every human had one red flag, what would mine be?
If we missed our flight, what could we do to pass the time at the airport?
If I suddenly became your exact height, would you still find me attractive?
I just got arrested. What's your guess on what I did?

posts.coverText: 3 dumb questions for him (but fun)

slideText.text: If you had 60 seconds to make me cry for $1M, what would you do?
If I said I bought something crazy, what would you guess it was?
If I forgot everything tomorrow, what's the first thing you'd tell me?

posts.coverText: Uncomfortable but healthy questions to ask your man

slideText.text: If someone told you I wasn't the right person for you, what would you say to defend us?
What's one small thing I do that means so much more to you than I realize?
What's a secret about yourself you've never shared with anyone but wish you could tell me?
Do you think I see you for who you really are, or just who I want you to be?

posts.coverText: How jealous is your boyfriend, really?

slideText.text: A guy buys me a drink at the bar. What do you do?
My ex likes my photo at 2am. What's your move?
I say a coworker is "really funny." What do you hear?
Be honest, how jealous do you get over me?

posts.coverText: 5 weird questions to ask your boyfriend

slideText.text: What do you think I'd complain about the most as an old lady?
What's the littlest thing you think I'd actually cry over?
What's the weirdest thing I do without realizing it?
If I started a fight with a stranger, what do you think it would be over?
Which version of me scares you the most: tired me, hungry me, or bored me?

posts.coverText: 7 questions for couples to talk all night long

slideText.text: What's something you'd miss about me if I suddenly disappeared from your life tomorrow?
If I let you go through my messages for one minute, where would you look first?
What's one promise you know you couldn't keep if I asked you to make it?
If you had to pick one memory of us to live in, but you lost all the others, which would it be?
Is there one mistake you secretly think I'll never forgive you for, even if I said it was okay?
Do you ever wish I was just a little more like someone else?
If I suddenly stopped trying, what's the first thing you'd notice missing?

posts.coverText: 5 extra fun questions

slideText.text: What am I better at than anyone else you've met?
If you could ban me from doing one thing, what would it be?
What is the most "me" moment you have ever seen?
What is one habit of mine you secretly find funny?
What kind of mood do I bring into a room first?

posts.coverText: Only ask your partner these questions if you think you're actually in love

slideText.text: Would you choose me again if you knew everything you know now?
What's something you've learned about love from being with me?
What moment of ours would you want to relive?
What do I give you that you didn't know you needed?
Who's the first person you told about me?

posts.coverText: 5 cute questions to ask your partner

slideText.text: What's one of the first moments with me that made you think, "This could be something special"?
Is there a little routine or habit we have that you hope never changes?
What's something I could surprise you with that you'd really enjoy?
What's something you can't wait to experience together in the future?
What do you think has been one of our most important moments together so far?

posts.coverText: 5 funny questions for late-night laughs

slideText.text: If I was cloned and there were two of me, would that be your paradise or your nightmare?
What is the absolute dumbest argument we've ever had that we still remember?
If you had to rate my driving skills on a scale of 1 to 10 without lying, what would it be?
What's a weird food combination I eat that makes you question my choices?
If our lives were a comedy show, what would the title of the current season be?

I say another girl is my type.
I accidentally call you by my ex's name.
I follow a girl just because she's pretty.
I dream about cheating on you and tell you about it.
